======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 21-07-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 341, 342,
379, 323, 385, 387, 420, 465, 466, 467, 406, 504, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. This petitioner is alleged to have threatened the informant with pistol.
4. It is submitted on behalf of petitioner that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
The allegation of snatching mobile phone and golden chain is against co-accused Santosh Kumar.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30927 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 6.

Considering the nature of accusation and clean antecedent, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, let the above named petitioner be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the Rajeev Ranjan @ Raja vs The State Of Bihar on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197864753/
1 satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Muzaffarpur in connection with Sadar P.S. Case No. 100 of 2020,
subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) anay/-
